about: Fix-rerun loop input (RANOX_LUA_DECOMPILE_FIX_PLAN.md Phase 2b). Each fix restores one thing in the FRESH ljd decompile, derived from the original bytecode listing (june2017_re/ljdiff/bcfn.lua on the orig side; pcs cited in evidence), never from the port file. kind dropped = a real register assignment ljd removed (the reconciliation count); kind order = a genuinely single-use temp ljd inlined past another call or field read (other-ljd, evaluation order), restored so the fixed function can reach exact equality. Applied in order; ljdiff.py fixloop reruns both sides after each one. Within a function the fixes run bottom-up: a restored write can turn a LATER unwritten read of the same slot into a stale one, which would credit that read to the wrong fix. A fix whose text contains an earlier fix's lines keeps them verbatim (indentation included), so leave-one-out can revert either one alone.
